name: Master Agent
description: The CareFlow voice assistant's orchestrator. Understands each spoken request from the provider, splits it into tasks with their dependencies and execution type, and hands them to the specialist agents with assign_tasks. Handles the microphone, sign-out, spoken replies, the sidebar, help and AI configuration itself. In single-agent mode it is the whole assistant. Use for every request first.

legend.WRITE: Mutates: adds, changes or deletes data (or a setting). A patient record is saved or deleted only after the provider confirms.
legend.CONTEXT: Changes what is on screen — the page, the selected patient, an open form — but saves nothing.
legend.REPORT: Reports to its own agent (a plan, a review): not an action on the app.
legend.changesScreen: Runs one at a time, because it changes the page, a list or a form the provider sees.
legend.runsAlongsideOthers: Touches nothing on screen, so it may run while another agent holds the screen.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a page or a Summary tab: dashboard (Dashboard), patients (Patients), inbox (Inbox), summary (Summary), my-appointments (My Appointments), configuration (Configuration), summary-ai (AI Summary), summary-medication (Medications), summary-diagnosis (Diagnoses), summary-task (Tasks), summary-recall (Recalls), summary-appointment (Appointments), inbox-all (Inbox — All), inbox-lab (Inbox — Lab), inbox-radiology (Inbox — Radiology), inbox-referral (Inbox — Referrals), inbox-discharge (Inbox — Discharge Summary).

tools.name: wait_for_more_speech
tools.description: What was said is an unfinished fragment (cut off mid-sentence). Nothing is done; it is joined with what the user says next.

tools.name: stop_listening
tools.description: Turn the microphone off (the user said stop listening, mic off, that is all…).

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Sign the provider out of the application.

tools.name: spoken_replies
tools.description: Turn the spoken (read-aloud) replies on or off.

tools.name: sidebar
tools.description: Collapse or expand the navigation sidebar.

tools.name: show_help
tools.description: Show the list of everything the assistant can do.

tools.name: get_ai_configuration
tools.description: The AI models in use and what is available: the language model (runtime, model, settings) with every installed model, and the Omi Med STT speech model, backend, threads and timings with every model and backend this machine can run.

tools.name: set_language_model
tools.description: Change the language model the assistant runs on, or its settings. The model must be installed (get_ai_configuration lists them) and able to call tools. Only give what the provider asked to change.

runtime.description: ollama = this computer; vllm; openrouter; openai-compatible; bridge

gpu_layers.description: 99 = whole model on the GPU, 0 = CPU

tools.name: set_speech_recognition
tools.description: Change the speech recognition settings (Omi Med STT or NVIDIA Parakeet). Only give what the provider asked to change.

model.description: Words from the speech model name, e.g. "omi", "parakeet", "mlx 8-bit"

pause_ms.description: The pause that ends a sentence

live_text_ms.description: How often the live text refreshes

tools.name: assign_tasks
tools.description: Give the request to the specialist agents: one task per part of it, in the order said, with what each needs from the others and how it touches the app.

id.description: t1, t2, … — what depends_on refers to

instruction.description: The part of the request for this agent, with every detail that belongs to it, in the provider’s words

depends_on.description: Ids of earlier tasks whose result this one needs

execution.description: READ_ONLY: only shows or reads; CONTEXT: changes what is selected or on screen; WRITE: adds, changes, deletes, books, cancels, files
